inner_diameter_nm.comment: GSDMD pore inner diameter. Sborgi 2016 (EMBO J, PMID 27418190) AFM: ring diameters 21.2 +/- 5.6 nm (n=164). Xia 2021 (Nature, PMID 33883744) cryo-EM: 33-subunit pore, inner diameter ~215 Angstrom = 21.5 nm. Our corpus (gsdmd-pore-delivery-paradox.md line 40) states 10-20 nm as the working inner-diameter range. KPV (~1 nm) is 15-40x smaller than the pore radius, so pore is not a steric barrier regardless of which value in this range is used.

channel_length_nm.comment: Effective length of the transmembrane beta-barrel conduit. Lipid bilayer ~4-5 nm; the GSDMD beta-barrel spans and slightly protrudes. LOW sensitivity because for a wide short pore the access (convergence) resistance term (pi*r/2 ~= 15.7 nm at r=10 nm) dominates over the channel term L. Range 4-10 nm.

conduit_electrostatics: Xia 2021 (PMID 33883744): the GSDMD pore conduit is predominantly NEGATIVELY charged and preferentially passes positively-charged and neutral cargo over negatively-charged cargo of similar size (electrostatic filtering; demonstrated for mature vs pro-IL-1). KPV is net +1 -> electrostatically favored -> supports hindrance factor >= 1.

pores_per_pyroptotic_cell.comment: NAMED ASSUMPTION / design-space range. Neither Sborgi 2016 nor Xia 2021 reports a per-cell pore count (confirmed by full-text check: they characterize pore structure, not cellular abundance). Pyroptosis permeabilizes the whole cell (LDH release, propidium influx), which requires many pores; imaging shows heterogeneous fields of arcs/slits/rings. Central 200 is a mid estimate; the robustness sweep spans 10-10000. KEY RESULT: the equilibration verdict is robust for pores_per_cell >= ~10 (see analyze.py), so this poorly-constrained parameter does not drive the A1 flux verdict.

open_lifetime_seconds.comment: Pore open lifetime = 1-30 min. Our corpus (gsdmd-pore-delivery-paradox.md Open Question #4) states 'minutes to tens of minutes' before ESCRT-mediated membrane repair or cell lysis. This comp quantitatively answers that open question by computing what fraction of extracellular [KPV] the cell reaches within the lifetime. Range 60-1800 s.
